import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
t = int(input[0])
index = 1
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input[index])
    q = list(map(int, input[index+1:index+n+1]))
    min_perm = [0] * n
    max_perm = [0] * n
    available = list(range(1, n+1))
    used = [False] * (n+1)
    for i in range(n):
        while used[q[i]]:
            q[i] -= 1
        min_perm[i] = q[i]
        used[q[i]] = True
    used = [False] * (n+1)
    for i range(n-1, -1, -1):
        while used[q[i]]:
            q[i] -= 1
            if q[i] < available[-1]:
                available.pop()
        max_perm[i] = q[i]
        used[q[i]] = True
        if q[i] == available[-1]:
            available.pop()
    print(' '.join(map(str, min_perm)))
    print(' '.join(map(str, max_perm)))
    index += n + 1
